# Vehicle wheel

Query target: `VEHICLE_WHEEL`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

| Attribute | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [brakeTorque](#braketorque) | write | persistent brake torque |
| [driveTorque](#drivetorque) | write | persistent drive torque |
| [groundActorPath](#groundactorpath) | read | ground actor prim identity |
| [groundHitPosition](#groundhitposition) | read | contact hit position |
| [groundMaterialPath](#groundmaterialpath) | read | ground material prim identity |
| [groundPlane](#groundplane) | read | contact plane `(nx, ny, nz, d)`, `n dot p + d = 0` |
| [groundShapePath](#groundshapepath) | read | ground shape prim identity |
| [isOnGround](#isonground) | read | validity of the current ground-contact sample |
| [orientation](#orientation) | read | composed wheel rotation, xyzw |
| [position](#position) | read | composed wheel position |
| [rotationAngle](#rotationangle) | read | wheel rotation angle |
| [rotationSpeed](#rotationspeed) | read | wheel angular speed |

## brakeTorque

`f32`; units: [mass * distance^2 / sec^2](units.md#torque).

## Conditions

### Raw wheel

Only vehicles without a managed drive accept raw-wheel controls. Commands persist until replaced; invalid controls reject before mutation.

### Vehicle

Vehicles are unavailable on DirectGPU. Controls require compatible drive/chassis state and finite accepted values; writes preflight the group before mutation. Telemetry may omit incompatible rows.
